name: kanban_list_projects
description: List all projects, including archived ones, with card counts by status, blocked counts, owner-waiting counts, handoffs, and a dormant marker. A project is dormant when it has no incomplete cards and no open comment threads; a new card or comment reactivates it. Use this before starting work to find project IDs and handoffs.

name: kanban_create_project
description: Create a project only when kanban_list_projects shows that it does not already exist. The ID must be a lowercase alphanumeric slug with hyphens, 2 to 40 characters. If no color is provided, one is selected automatically.

color.description: Color in #RRGGBB format; selected automatically when omitted

name: kanban_list_events
description: List activity events from newest to oldest, showing who did what and when. Use this to review recent work by actor or project. Use next_before to fetch an earlier page.

limit.description: Number of items, 1 to 200; defaults to 50

before.description: Return only events with an ID below this value (pagination)

name: kanban_get_brief
description: Get a card's task package before starting, taking over, or handing off work. It includes core card fields, the description (task template, up to 4,000 characters by default), the latest [handoff] note, the three newest other notes, up to five open comment threads, and the project handoff (up to 1,000 characters), plus formatted text. When truncated, truncated=true; set full=true to remove all truncation.

full.description: When true, include all other notes and all open comment threads without truncation
